clue.text: Listener's help in puzzling met rapture

indicators.note: puzzling suggests the letters of met rapture are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is bewildered at meeting sheer ecstasy, with a nod to hearing aids.
explanation.definitionFit: An old horn-shaped device held to the ear helped the hard of hearing, so it is a listener's aid.

clue.text: Fit up an island

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: fit in the sense of capable gives able

explanation.surface: Someone sets up, or fits out, an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Elba is the Mediterranean island where Napoleon was exiled, so it is an example of an island.

clue.text: Italian food is consumed by king and emperor

indicators.note: consumed by says the word is is swallowed inside the royal pair

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for king (rex)
Otto was the name of several Holy Roman Emperors

explanation.surface: An Italian dish is eaten by a king and an emperor at a royal feast.
explanation.definitionFit: Risotto is a rice dish from Italy, so it is an Italian food by example.

clue.text: Exciting ride as ship goes under big wave

indicators.note: in a down clue, going under places the vessel below the wave

parts.note: a roller is a long heavy wave
a coaster is a ship trading along the coast

explanation.surface: A ship is swamped by a huge wave, which is thrilling in a frightening way.
explanation.definitionFit: A fairground railway of steep drops and turns gives a thrilling ride.

clue.text: Spoil something sweet putting in alternative herb

parts.note: to spoil is to mar

indicators.note: putting in means the alternative word is placed inside the sweet thing

parts.note: jam is a sweet fruit preserve
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A cook ruins a dessert by adding a different herb.
explanation.definitionFit: Marjoram is an aromatic plant of the mint family used in cooking, an example of a herb.

clue.text: Uncover base trade fairs

indicators.note: in a down clue the base is the bottom letter, which is dropped here

parts.note: to uncover is to expose

explanation.surface: Someone exposes the crooked underpinnings of trade fairs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'base' looks like an adjective (low, corrupt) but means the bottom letter of the down word, removed: EXPOSE loses its final E.
explanation.definitionFit: Expos are short for expositions, large exhibitions where traders show goods.

clue.text: Confusion in the City of London on a grand scale

indicators.note: in places the confusion inside the postcode letters

parts.note: EC is the postcode district of the City of London
pi (or pie) is a printers' term for jumbled type, hence confusion

explanation.surface: Chaos in London's financial district is happening on a huge scale.
explanation.definitionFit: Epic as an adjective means heroic or vast in scale, like an epic poem.

clue.text: Nobleman taken in by a collector of gems

indicators.note: taken in by puts the nobleman inside the word for a

parts.note: per means a, as in so much per day
an earl is a nobleman

explanation.surface: An aristocrat is swindled by a jewel collector.
explanation.definitionFit: A pearler is a diver who gathers pearls, which are gems, from oyster beds.

clue.text: Know-all always would get in to get on

indicators.note: get in to says the pieces go inside the word for getting on

parts.note: people who click get on well
ever means always
'd is the contraction of would

explanation.surface: A smart alec is sure he would always manage to get ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: A clever dick is British slang for a smug person who thinks they know everything.

clue.text: Swiss city giving support to pound

parts.note: a base is a support
L is the abbreviation for pound (libra)

explanation.surface: A Swiss city props up the value of sterling.
explanation.definitionFit: Basel is a city in Switzerland on the Rhine, an example of a Swiss city.

clue.text: Reject and criticise person who's fooled around with one being taken in

indicators.note: being taken in places the pieces inside the word for criticise

parts.note: to rate is to scold, an old sense of criticise

indicators.note: around means the word for the fooled person is turned back to front

parts.note: a dupe is someone who has been fooled
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone spurns and condemns a philanderer who seduced another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fooled around' reads as philandering, but splits: the fooled person is the piece, and 'around' turns it backwards. Rate is an old verb meaning to scold.
explanation.definitionFit: To repudiate is to refuse to accept or to disown, a synonym of reject.

clue.text: Dog kept by Jordan died in Monte Carlo

indicators.note: kept by signals the letters sit within the phrase that follows

explanation.surface: A dog belonged to someone named Jordan who died in Monte Carlo.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dandie Dinmont is a Scottish terrier breed named after a character in a Walter Scott novel.

clue.text: The force constituting heart-throbs for many teenage girls

definitions.meaning: a jocular name for the police, whose uniforms are blue
young men idolised by girls, read as lads in a blue uniform

explanation.surface: The police make up a crush for many teenage girls.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a familiar nickname for police officers, and boys literally describes young male idols.

clue.text: Doctor dashing with the poison

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so the letters of dashing and the are altered

explanation.surface: A medic hurries off with the poison, like a villain in a mystery.
explanation.definitionFit: Deadly nightshade, or belladonna, is a poisonous plant, so the name stands for a poison.

clue.text: Well protected from cold rain pouring

indicators.note: pouring suggests the letters of cold rain tumble into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone is well sheltered from a cold downpour.
explanation.definitionFit: Ironclad literally means armoured with iron plates, hence very well protected.

clue.text: Great hunter disturbed minor deity at first

indicators.note: disturbed means the letters of minor are thrown into a new order
at first takes only the opening letter of deity

explanation.surface: A mighty hunter troubled a lesser god in the beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: Nimrod is described in Genesis as a mighty hunter before the Lord, so his name means a great hunter.

clue.text: The tanks deployed in Central Asian city

indicators.note: deployed suggests the letters of the tanks are spread out and rearranged

explanation.surface: Armoured vehicles are sent into a city in Central Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Tashkent is the capital of Uzbekistan, an example of a Central Asian city.

clue.text: One paid to take out one trademark in Chinese

indicators.note: in places the pieces inside the word for Chinese

parts.note: the Han are the majority ethnic group of China
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone pays to get a branded item delivered from a Chinese takeaway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take out' suggests a takeaway meal; here it means kill.
explanation.definitionFit: A hired assassin is paid to kill, and take out is slang for killing someone.

clue.text: Master tucking into very large drink gets shake

indicators.note: tucking into puts the master inside the large drink

parts.note: a treble is a triple measure of spirits
M is the abbreviation for master, as in an MA degree

explanation.surface: A master gulps down a huge drink and is left with the shakes.
explanation.definitionFit: To tremble is to quiver or shake, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Great terror about medical upset — widespread disease

indicators.note: about places the panic around the other piece

parts.note: panic is sudden great fear

indicators.note: upset means the short form of medical is turned over

explanation.surface: Fear spreads amid medical disruption during a widespread epidemic.
explanation.definitionFit: A pandemic is an outbreak of disease spreading across countries or the world.

clue.text: Oliver perhaps makes outrageous claim about us

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go around the word us
outrageous suggests the letters of claim are wildly rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone named Oliver makes a shocking claim about us.
explanation.definitionFit: Oliver! is a famous stage show with songs, an example of a musical.

clue.text: Perhaps trifles about love

parts.note: trifles are desserts and also trivial things, while about love points to romantic murmurings

explanation.surface: Maybe little trivialities concerning romance.
explanation.walkthrough: Trifles may be sweets (puddings) or nothings (trivia); together they make the endearments lovers whisper.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means the affectionate, meaningless words lovers say to each other.

clue.text: The Sailor Man's dainty dish?

parts.note: Popeye the Sailor Man's girlfriend is ... Oyl, and a dish is slang for an attractive person; the fruit is also a dainty dish

explanation.surface: What delicate food does the cartoon sailor enjoy?
explanation.walkthrough: Popeye is 'the Sailor Man'; his sweetheart is Olive Oyl, and 'dish' is slang for an attractive person.
explanation.definitionFit: The small fruit is a delicate morsel, and it is also the name of Popeye's girlfriend.

clue.text: Architect right in three ways

indicators.note: in puts the right inside the three directions

parts.note: W, E and N are three compass directions

explanation.surface: A designer gets it right three ways over.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Christopher Wren designed St Paul's Cathedral, a famous example of an architect.

clue.text: Fruit French hostelry keeps in

indicators.note: keeps means the inn holds the next word inside it

parts.note: an auberge is a French inn

explanation.surface: A French inn keeps fruit in stock.
explanation.definitionFit: The aubergine, or eggplant, is botanically a berry and so a fruit.

clue.text: Row about science gets award

indicators.note: about puts the rowing word around the science abbreviation

parts.note: an oar is used to row
SC is an abbreviation for science

explanation.surface: An argument over science earns a prize.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' looks like a quarrel; here it is the verb for rowing a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: The Oscar is the Academy Award statuette given for film achievement.

clue.text: Relations are finally over for them

definitions.text: Relations are finally over for them

parts.words: Relations are finally over for them
parts.note: relations here means relationships, which have ended for former partners

explanation.surface: Family links have at last ended for some people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relations' suggests relatives; it means relationships, now over.
explanation.definitionFit: Former spouses or partners are people whose relationships have ended.

clue.text: Sporting event held in Irish town mostly

parts.note: pent means held in, as in pent-up

indicators.note: mostly drops the last letter of the town's name

parts.note: Athlone is a town in the Irish midlands

explanation.surface: A sporting event is held mainly in a town in Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held in' looks like a link to the town but gives PENT.
explanation.definitionFit: The pentathlon is an athletics or Olympic contest of five events, an example of a sporting event.
